get.description:
Stop Monitor.
Transport types:
Regionalbahn , Regionalexpress , Bus, S-Bahn, Tram, Schienenersatzverkehr, Ruf-Bus
get.summary: Shows all trips at a given stop, date and time

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: Limited rate key.

parameters.name: stopid
parameters.description:
StopId of the Stop. It is also possible to specify a koordinate parameter instead of the stopid.
Example:koord=51.3243,12.3336

parameters.name: date
parameters.description:
date to be queried. The format is YYYYMMDD,
Example:20200507 That stands for 7th. may 2020
If no time parameter is specified, then the whole day is returned

parameters.name: time
parameters.description:
time to be queried. The format is HH:MM,
Example:11:35

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: results with arrival_time not later than ``minutes`` after ``time`` are returned. Default 60.

parameters.name: max_items
parameters.description: Max. number of data returned. Default all.

parameters.name: min_items
parameters.description: Minimum number of results returned. Default 0. If set the minutes parameter is internally enlarged (max. 3 days) until minimum number is reached.

parameters.name: mockup
parameters.description: Sends back a mostly fixed data set modelling different special cases that might occur in practice.

parameters.name: depOnly
parameters.description: Endpoint only gives back departures, i.e. trip that has final stop in given stopid is not listed.

parameters.name: arrOnly
parameters.description: Endpoint only gives back arrivals, i.e. trip that has first stop in given stopid is not listed.
